data.description:
## Description

**What**: Add `depends_on` link from each pending platform-integration epic to A0 (188c-47e4-5abe-4b9c) and add a one-line "blocked on A0" comment to each. Targets: 70d5-37ee (Java), jira-dig-1582 (Terraform), jira-dig-1583 (Jenkins), ee22-4785 (.NET), 622a-3955 (Azure DevOps).
**Why**: Prevents downstream epics from beginning before the array schema activates and from shipping a second migration.
**Scope**:
- IN: Five `ticket link <epic-id> 188c-47e4-5abe-4b9c depends_on` calls; five one-line `ticket comment <epic-id> "Blocked on A0 (188c-47e4-5abe-4b9c) — wait for namespaced array schema before implementing stack-keyed conditionals."`
- OUT: Coordinating with 136b-6758 (separate handshake — single line clarification comment recorded as part of S1 schema doc).

## Done Definitions
- When complete, each of 70d5-37ee, jira-dig-1582, jira-dig-1583, ee22-4785, 622a-3955 has a `depends_on` link to 188c-47e4-5abe-4b9c ← Satisfies: SC5
- When complete, each of those epics has the one-line "blocked on A0" comment ← Satisfies: SC5

## Considerations
- [Maintainability] Confirm each target ticket exists via `ticket exists <id>` before linking; tolerate aliases vs full IDs

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
data.title: As an epic stakeholder, downstream platform-integration epics are linked and noted as blocked on A0
